solutions.title: Enterprise Agent Trust
solutions.summary: A permissioned enterprise mobile-agent control layer with deterministic policy and human review.
solutions.detailMarkdown:
**Today:** the research kernel includes Swift policy decisions, approval boundaries and bounded audit concepts; system App Intents and integration tests remain in review. This is not an enterprise SDK or a production deployment.

**B2B use case:** a staff member reviews a synthetic task proposed by local AI; Swift code decides which capabilities can be exercised and a human explicitly approves a bounded write. A model suggestion never grants permissions.

**Missing before a customer pilot:** independently verified tenant and role enforcement, organization identity, managed app configuration, server-side authorization, data-processing terms, audit export and security testing. No generic control of other iPhone apps is promised.

See the repository's B2B solution portfolio for proof gates and ownership boundaries.

solutions.title: Field Evidence Workbench
solutions.summary: Reviewable on-device field findings for inspectors and loss-adjustment teams.
solutions.detailMarkdown:
**Today:** the separate Fieldglass prototype provides native Vision/OCR experiments, draft editing, fixed-app MCP tools and synthetic receipt verification in the simulator. Physical iPhone/ChatGPT acceptance is not established.

**B2B use case:** an inspector reviews a fictional asset observation, corrects a draft and decides whether to retain or cancel it. The original source, user action and verified outcome must remain distinguishable.

**Missing before a pilot:** consent, image and location minimization, retention, provenance hashing, offline failure handling, device installation and verified role-bound backend authorization. No real customer images or claims are bundled.

solutions.title: Insurance Risk Assistant
solutions.summary: Proposed bridge from approved mobile property surveys to bounded insurance risk-review drafts.
solutions.detailMarkdown:
**Today:** iGentic has policy/draft primitives, and separate catastrophe-data and stochastic-insurance research exists. **There is no working iPhone-to-insurance-engine integration or approved risk model here.**

**B2B use case:** a fictional survey of an insured building produces a structured proposal. After human review, a future independently authorized domain adapter could request a **synthetic** risk-review result with explicit provenance and assumptions.

**Missing before a pilot:** permitted source data and licenses, independent model validation, tenant isolation, geolocation/privacy controls, actual backend authorization, failure receipts and human-underwriter review. Never display prototype output as a premium, coverage decision, Solvency II value or production catastrophe loss.

solutions.title: Managed Device Diagnostics
solutions.summary: Bounded fixed-app diagnostics for enterprise iPhone support, not unrestricted remote control.
solutions.detailMarkdown:
**Today:** iPhone Connect supports typed local MCP diagnostics, fixture-backed approval policy tests and fixed-owned-app navigation proposals. A successful fixture or simulator test does not prove physical iPhone connectivity.

**B2B use case:** a support operator requests a coarse diagnostic state from an explicitly enrolled and authorized company app, reviews a bounded action and checks a receipt.

**Missing before a pilot:** company enrollment and identity, device/session ownership, managed app distribution, documented wired/network channels, admin logging and independent physical-device acceptance. Do not confuse Apple Business/MDM configuration with arbitrary taps across apps or remote cellular access.

solutions.title: Private Model Evaluation
solutions.summary: Evaluate on-device model proposals while keeping policy, scopes and approvals deterministic.
solutions.detailMarkdown:
**Today:** the iOS 27 research stack contains Apple Foundation Models proposal experiments and open-weight artifact admission tests. A research test is not a deployed managed model fleet.

**B2B use case:** a company compares synthetic task proposals by language, model and device class, while identical deterministic Swift policy gates reject unsupported and unsafe actions.

**Missing before a pilot:** explicit hardware/locale checks, license clearance, versioned signed model provenance, isolated evaluation data, accuracy and failure budgets, and a rollback contract. iOS 27 alone does not guarantee model availability.

solutions.title: Retail Inventory Assistant
solutions.summary: A proposed provenance-aware lookup workflow for catalog and inventory teams.
solutions.detailMarkdown:
**Today:** iGentic can locally display bundled discovery content, but no commerce adapter, stock database, customer catalog, live scanner or point-of-sale system is connected.

**B2B use case:** store staff review a synthetic product identity and source evidence before suggesting a catalog correction. A future adapter must verify rights, ownership and actor role before any change.

**Missing before a pilot:** rights-cleared catalog data, identity and variant validation, tenant-level stock permissions, scanner quality benchmarks, API contracts, idempotency and approval for inventory writes. No payments or automated listings are authorized.
